subject: Medisys private deployment readiness — intake & environment runlist
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@medisys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@infra-partner.com>
Date: 2028-07-18 09:12 PDT
Subject: Private deploy intake — Medisys environment details and timing

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're moving the private deployment conversation forward with our infra and security teams and want to get an intake runlist together so we can schedule the activation window. Attached are our latest SOC2 snapshot and a rough network diagram. High level asks from our side:

- Confirmation of required service account types and their minimum privileges
- Expected egress IPs or ranges we should whitelist on our side
- KMS/HSM support and any customer-managed key requirements (we use an HSM-backed KMS)
- What evidence you need for our compliance pack and expected SLAs for Dedicated-private mode

We have a target week of Aug 6–9 for the initial environment validation, but can be flexible for earlier engineering windows. Can you send a concise checklist we can run internally and share back before the kickoff? Also looping Tom from our cloud integrator for networking details.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Wu
Head of Cloud Security, Medisys Health
alice.wu@medisys.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachments: medisys_soc2_v3.pdf (stub), medisys_network_diagram_v2.png (stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@infra-partner.com>
Date: 2028-07-18 09:48 PDT
Subject: Re: Private deploy intake — Medisys environment details and timing

Alice — thanks for the packet and the proposed dates. Looping in our infra lead (Karthik), onboarding PM (Laura), and security ops (Mina). Below is an "intake runlist" we use for private deployments — condensed version for your team to fill and return. I highlighted items we commonly see missing so you can prepare ahead of the Aug window.

Intake runlist (concise):
1) Account and tenant info
   - Preferred account name and owner contact
   - IAM service account email(s) you will provision (we recommend a dedicated ephemeral deploy account and a long-lived monitoring account)
2) Network & routing
   - Egress IP ranges to whitelist (we provide final ranges after sizing)
   - VPN/Private Interconnect details or peering instructions (BGP ASNs if applicable)
   - Allowed outbound ports (443, 80, 53 for DNS; additional ports for custom connectors)
3) Key management
   - Do you require customer-managed keys (CMK) in an HSM? If yes, provide KMS ARN and who owns rotation
4) Access & audit
   - SSH/RDP jump host plan for our ops if needed (list of bastion IPs)
   - Audit log shipping destination (S3/GCS/Azure blob) + retention policy
5) Compliance evidence
   - SOC2 snapshot (received)
   - Any additional regulatory constraints (e.g., HIPAA BAAs)
6) Test traffic plan
   - Sample requests per second, average seq length for models, and a small test corpus for quality checks

Action items for Redwood:
- We'll produce a minimal egress IP list within 24 business hours once you confirm expected throughput.
- Karthik will send a technical gating checklist (ports, service accounts, DNS validation) by EOD.
- Laura will create the onboarding ticket in our systems and share a HubSpot link and read-only drive folder.

Can you confirm whether you require the HSM-backed CMK for token encryption at rest, or whether a Redwood-managed KMS is acceptable for the initial validation? That will determine the KMS handoff steps.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
(415) 555-0122

--
Note: we'll treat the SOC snapshot as sensitive; please confirm any redaction needs for the shared drive link.

From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@medisys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@infra-partner.com>
Date: 2028-07-18 10:23 PDT
Subject: Re: Private deploy intake — Medisys environment details and timing

Irene — thanks, that list looks good and clean. Quick answers inline:

- Account name: medisys-redwood-prod; primary owner: Alice Wu (alice.wu@medisys.com)
- We'll create two service accounts: medisys-redwood-deploy@medisys.com (ephemeral) and medisys-redwood-monitor@medisys.com (long-lived)
- Egress: we'll whitelist 35.192.0.0/14 and 35.200.0.0/13 initially; final list pending your sizing note
- KMS: we require HSM-backed CMK for secrets at rest (company policy). KMS ARN attached in the CSV (account_onboarding_sheet.csv stub).
- Audit logs: pushing to s3://medisys-infra-logs with 7-year retention
- Test traffic: aiming for 150 rps peak, average seq length ~120 tokens. We'll provide a 500-line sample prompt file by tomorrow.

Tom from Infra Partner will coordinate the BGP peering if we need it, but we can start with a VPN overlay.

Attaching the onboarding sheet with the KMS ARN and owner contacts. Let us know if you need anything else before the call. I'm available 1–4pm PT today if you want a short sync.

Best,
Alice

Attachments: account_onboarding_sheet.csv (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@medisys.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@infra-partner.com>
Date: 2028-07-18 11:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Private deploy intake — technical gating checklist and next steps

Hi all — quick technical gating items from Redwood infra. I'll also paste these into the onboarding ticket so nothing is missed.

Redwood technical gating checklist (short):
- Service accounts: please provision the two emails Alice listed with the following minimal roles:
  - deploy account: compute.admin (to allow image/pod staging), secretsmanager.read, storage.objectAdmin limited to onboarding bucket
  - monitor account: logs.viewer, metrics.reader, storage.objectViewer for logs bucket
- Networking:
  - Confirm whether you will NAT traffic through your VPC or allow provider-provided egress. If NAT on your side, we only need the CIDR ranges to be stable during testing windows.
  - Add 443 outbound to redwood-managed endpoints; for initial run use egress IPs we provide (we will send list by 07/19 11am PT)
  - DNS: ensure an internal CNAME for the hostnames we provide, or add the A records to your zone once we confirm config
- KMS/HSM:
  - We support customer-owned CMKs. For HSM-backed keys we require a short permission document for key use by Redwood runtime (we'll provide a template).
- Telemetry & logs:
  - Create an S3 bucket with write access to our logging principal OR provide cross-account role for pushing logs.
- Test traffic:
  - Provide a small synthetic test set (500 lines) and a target ramp plan (e.g., 10rps -> 50rps -> 150rps over 30 minutes)

Operational notes:
- We'll run an initial connectivity smoke test that verifies TLS, mutual auth where used, KMS encryption handshake, and a token-level latency baseline. Expect ~2–4 hours for smoke tests.
- If you require an HSM CMK, please sign and return the KMS access template before the smoke test.

I'll share the egress IP list and the firewall allowlist doc by tomorrow AM. Laura — can you please create the onboarding ticket and include the HubSpot deal link?

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
